user.title: Solar Accelerator - API Key
user.description:
Enter the API key generated in the Solar Accelerator dashboard.

Find your key at: Integrations → Inverters → Home Assistant

choose_source.title: Inverter - Data Source
choose_source.description:
Select how your inverter is exposed in Home Assistant (integration type), or choose manual entity mapping.

**Solarman / SolarAssistant** - automatic mapping; you'll pick the manufacturer and model in the next step.

**Manual** - manually select each entity from Home Assistant.

choose_model.title: Inverter - Manufacturer & Model
choose_model.description:
Source: {source_label}

Select the inverter manufacturer and model.

prefix.title: Inverter - Entity Prefix

entities_pv.title: Entity Mapping - Photovoltaic Panels (PV)
entities_pv.description:
Select Home Assistant entities corresponding to PV panel data.

All entities must be mapped.

entities_battery.title: Entity Mapping - Battery
entities_battery.description: Select Home Assistant entities corresponding to battery data.

entities_inverter.title: Entity Mapping - Inverter
entities_inverter.description: Select Home Assistant entities corresponding to inverter data.

entities_grid.title: Entity Mapping - Grid
entities_grid.description: Select Home Assistant entities corresponding to grid data.

data_description.grid_power: + import from grid, - export to grid

entities_load.title: Entity Mapping - Load
entities_load.description: Select Home Assistant entities corresponding to load data.

entities_temp.title: Entity Mapping - Temperatures
entities_temp.description:
Select Home Assistant entities corresponding to temperature data.

Data will be sent automatically at every full hour.

ev_charger.title: EV Charger
ev_charger.description: Do you have an EV charger integrated in Home Assistant via OCPP?

data.ev_enabled: I have an EV charger via OCPP

ev_choose_mode.title: EV Charger - Configuration
ev_choose_mode.description:
Select how to map charger entities.

**Prefix** - automatic mapping for OCPP integration. Just provide the entity prefix (Charge Point ID).

**Manual** - manually select each entity from Home Assistant.

ev_prefix.title: EV Charger - Entity Prefix
ev_prefix.description:
Enter the charger entity prefix — this is the Charge Point ID from the OCPP integration.

Example: if your entities are named `sensor.arccharger_power_active_import`, the prefix is `arccharger`.

entities_ev_charger.title: Entity Mapping - EV Charger
entities_ev_charger.description:
Select Home Assistant entities corresponding to EV charger data (OCPP).

All entities must be mapped.
